component.name: PolyMesh
component.summary: Adaptive polyhedral FEA for desktop, CLI, and web

description.p: PolyMesh imports STEP and BRep CAD, creates geometry-aware volume meshes, applies face fixtures and loads, solves linear elasticity, and displays von Mises stress, displacement, and ZZ error estimates.
The command-line and browser companions support repeatable mesh, solve, diagnostic, render, and advisor workflows.
Multi-platform release: relocatable Linux x86-64, Windows x64, and macOS Apple-silicon archives.

Adds the polymesh-webd local web server and browser client, the Chudware desktop theme with a guided study flow, live mesh-growth and advisor activation rails, and real residual and ZZ convergence plots.
First public Linux release of the PolyMesh CLI, desktop, and web applications.
